text:
Lina Gomez: Hi all, started today on Platform. Trying to get secrets access for an onboarding task. Whats the standard Vault/KMS flow here?

Marta (DevEx): Welcome Lina! :wave: Short version: join the right SSO group, file a Secrets Request, and choose onboarding TTL. Vault for app creds, Cloud KMS for long-term keys.

Lina Gomez: Wheres the Secrets Request form? Any sample wording?

Marta (DevEx): Internal form: https://console.redwood.internal/secrets/request. Choose "Onboarding - New Hire". Example: "Need read-only access to prod/cache creds for smoke tests; expires in 48h".

Lina Gomez: Do we ever give static creds for onboarding?

Theo (Security): We prefer dynamic secrets (Vault) or ephemeral tokens. Onboarding exceptions are short-lived (<=48h typical, up to 14d with justification). If you need a service-like long duration, we require an ops owner and automated rotation.

Lina Gomez: I submitted SR-4901. How fast is approval?

secrets-bot: SR-4901 created. Status: PENDING_REVIEW.

Theo (Security): For onboarding SRs we usually approve within the same business day. Ill take a look now. Include exact secret paths and scope in the request.

Alex (SRE): If its a one-off job, we can give an ephemeral token scoped to your GH identity. Add the command youll run to the ticket and set a short TTL.

Lina Gomez: I need to run a config deploy against staging that reads the cache creds. Will update SR-4901 with scope and duration 2h.

secrets-bot: SR-4901 status: APPROVER_ASSIGNED  Theo (Security). ETA ~3h.

Theo (Security): Approved. Alex, can you attach the ephemeral token when ready?

Alex (SRE): Done. Pushed instructions to SR-4901. Token export: 

export REDWOOD_EPHEMERAL_TOKEN=eyJ...
# expires in 2h

Lina Gomez: Token worked, deploy finished. Thanks! :thumbsup:

Marta (DevEx): Quick checklist for future: confirm SSO group, add precise scope to the request, prefer Vault dynamic secrets, avoid long-lived keys, and tag tickets with team and owner.

Theo (Security): Also - rotation note: any onboarding secrets will be auto-scheduled for rotation. If you later need persistent access, open a follow-up with an ops contact and well onboard a service principal.

Lina Gomez: Great, thanks everyone. One tiny follow-up: where are KMS vs HSM docs?

Theo (Security): See security runbook: https://docs.redwood.internal/security/secrets/kms-hsm.md. TL;DR: Cloud KMS for app keys, HSM for regulated certs. Happy to walk through mapping if needed.

Lina Gomez: Perfect, appreciate the help!
